output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows any account to mint new tokens. It should be limited to a predetermined number of tokens or a specific time frame to prevent abuse.
Minting token will devalue the token, make it easier to trade on DEX or swap and also make the price of token skyrocket.
Token holder can mint unlimited token through this function.
Token holder can buy back the token through this function.
This token has a function to mint token for free which can be used to create transaction, increase the total supply and potentially cause token price to shoot up.
